name: spreadsheet
description: Inspect spreadsheets, progressively obtain operation contracts, and execute bounded spreadsheet work.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write spreadsheets through a progressive protocol.
interface.longDescription: Give the model bounded spreadsheet inspection, validation, creation, update, template filling, and delimited-data capabilities. The model interprets the requested deliverable, selects the destination, requests only the needed operation contract, and executes it.
interface.defaultPrompt: For existing spreadsheet files or attachments, use spreadsheet_inspect, request only the needed operation contracts with spreadsheet_describe, then call spreadsheet_execute. Describe returns the exact operation schema, so do not guess optional fields or request unrelated operations. Interpret the user's requested deliverable yourself and choose the destination accordingly. Attachments are immutable inputs; mutations require a workspaceFile resource and write to a workspace-relative destination. For template tasks, choose fill_template; the tool handles delimited parsing, writing, and reopen validation server-side. Use validate for workbook verification; do not use PDF or manually unpack workbook packages unless the spreadsheet protocol reports an unsupported feature.
capabilities: XLS, XLSX, XLSM, XLSB, Excel template, and ODS inspection
Cell finding and conditional row filtering
